_readme: Don't Miss placements (DEC-025). Each entry features ONE existing event. eventId is the id= in the event's event.html?id=... link. Order here is the order on the homepage; at most 3 show. Remove an entry (or set `to`) to stop featuring it. eyebrow and reason are optional editorial text. Selection is editorial only and is never paid for.

placements.reason: Montréal's Ballets Jazz company brings its athletic blend of jazz, ballet and modern dance to the Detroit Opera House.
A major retrospective of metro Detroit-born designer Anna Sui, with more than 100 looks from her archive.
A six-decade retrospective by longtime Detroit artist Pat Duff, opening with a free reception.
